one_liner: Customer service helpdesk and ticketing platform for e-commerce brands.
auth_notes: Supports Basic Authentication with email and API key, and OAuth2 for public apps.
verdict_reason: Gorgias provides a comprehensive REST API with standard authentication mechanisms and detailed developer documentation.

extras.rate_limit_note: OAuth2 apps can make 80 requests in a 20 second window.

evidence.quote: To authenticate API requests, Gorgias uses HTTP Basic Authentication with three pieces of information: your base API URL, your email address, and an API key.
In order to be able to have an approved public app with Gorgias, it is required that the app is using OAuth2 for authentication.
